recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, high-key studio portrait featuring two instances of the same subject side-by-side, interacting as if they are two different people. The composition is anchored by a stark white background and bold, vertically compressed typography across the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject interaction through physical contact (arm over shoulder)
Contrast between vibrant red and deep black apparel
Typographic alignment spanning the full width of the subjects
Symmetrical balance created by the dual-subject arrangement
coreInvariants: Direct eye contact with the viewer

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two waist-up figures centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The point of contact where the arm rests on the shoulder, creating a central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the large top-tier text down to the faces, then follow the arm across to the second figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space at the top and sides to emphasize the subjects and text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (secondary subject garment and primary text fill)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-contrast values with a single saturated primary red against neutral black and white.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick verticals and thin horizontals
Tight letter spacing for the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' has a very tight, vertical curve
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying the tracking and color of the same font family to create hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Thin red outlines on black text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed, high-contrast serif look.
Provides the sharp serifs and verticality required.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of two identical men standing side-by-side against a pure white background. One man wears a bright red t-shirt, the other a black button-down shirt. The man in red has his arm around the shoulder of the man in black. Even, soft lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text at the top. The first line should be ultra-condensed black serif text with a thin red outline. The second line should be smaller, red serif text with extremely wide tracking, justified to the width of the first line.

verificationChecks: Is the top text vertically stretched?
Does the subtitle have wide letter spacing?
Are the two subjects interacting physically?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Check for typographic alignment with subject shoulders
Ensure no shadows fall on the white background
Verify the red and black color balance between the two subjects
Confirm the verticality of the primary font
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + High-Key Background + Ultra-Condensed Serif Header + Wide-Tracked Subtitle
